=== bi-darken
--- main
A : %darken("red", 10) %darken("#FF0000", 50) %darken("#F00", 0) %darken("red", 100) %darken("red", -50) %darken("red", 200)
A : %darken("white", 10) %darken("black", 10) %darken("#80FF0000", 10) %darken("transparent", 10) %darken("automatic", 10)
A : %darken("?red:blue", 10) %darken("red-blue", 10) %darken("red/blue", 10) %darken("#8", 10) %darken("Red", 33) %darken("#red", 10)
A : %darken("RED", 10) %darken("lightGreen", 25) %darken("#123456", 1) %darken("#123", 77) %darken("red", "x") %darken("background", 5)
=== bi-darken-bad
--- main

--- main

=== bi-darken-empty
--- main
A : %darken("", 10)
=== bi-darken-scheme-bad
--- main
A : %darken("?red:nocolor", 10)
=== bi-lighten
--- main
A : %lighten("red", 10) %lighten("#FF0000", 50) %lighten("navy", 100) %lighten("red", -50) %lighten("black", 50)
A : %lighten("white", 10) %lighten("#80123456", 10) %lighten("transparent", 10) %lighten("#7F7F7F", 3) %lighten("blue", 2147483647)
!$c = %lighten("gray", 20)
A : $c
=== bi-lighten-bad
--- main
!$c = %lighten("nocolor", 20)

=== bi-hsl-color
--- main
